## The decision problem

A student has to choose a laptop for the next semester. Three candidates
with very different profiles, traded off on three criteria:

- **Price**: the cheaper, the better (derived automatically from the
  `price` attribute of each alternative via a `pairwiseFunction`).
- **Battery**: battery hours are directly comparable, so they are used
  as `score`s via a `scoreFunction`.
- **Ecosystem**: purely subjective pairwise preferences.

This exercises the three preference styles of the package in a single,
compact model (`laptop.ahp`, shipped in `inst/extdata`):

```{r show-file}
ahpFile <- system.file("extdata", "laptop.ahp", package="ahp")
cat(readChar(ahpFile, file.info(ahpFile)$size))
```

## Load, calculate, analyze

```{r run}
library(ahp)
laptopAhp <- Load(ahpFile)
Calculate(laptopAhp)
Analyze(laptopAhp)
```

The Chromebook wins (44.7%), driven by the Price criterion, which carries
more than half of the total weight (54.0%). The same analysis as a
color-coded HTML table:

```{r table}
AnalyzeTable(laptopAhp)
```

And as a decision tree with priorities and inconsistencies:

```{r visualize}
Visualize(laptopAhp)
```

## Printing the colored table in Typst/PDF

`AnalyzeTable()` returns a `formattable` object: an HTML table with
colors. Typst does not understand HTML, so the table cannot be rendered
as text in a Quarto `format: typst` document. The working approach is
to screenshot the table to PNG and embed the image:

```{r export, eval=FALSE}
w <- formattable::as.htmlwidget(AnalyzeTable(laptopAhp))
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(w, "laptop-table.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
webshot2::webshot("laptop-table.html", "laptop-table.png",
                  selector = ".formattable_widget", delay = 1)
```

This needs a Chromium/Chrome installation (`webshot2` finds it
automatically; otherwise set the `CHROME_PATH` environment variable).
The old recipe based on `webshot` (PhantomJS) no longer works:
PhantomJS has been abandoned since 2018, and `webshot::webshot()`
fails silently without producing any image when it is missing.

The resulting PNG embeds cleanly in a `.qmd` with `format: typst`:

```markdown
![Laptop choice: analysis table](laptop-table.png)
```

![Laptop choice: analysis table](laptop-table.png)
